**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Meridian — searches for "solicit", "induce", "employ or engage" and "hire" surfaced no restrictive covenant. § 12.3 goes further and affirmatively records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment, while expressly preserving our right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment. This sits at the playbook's preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so nothing to negotiate here.
